    all_outline_pixels = []
    for n in small_gray:

    rows = [p[0] for p in all_outline_pixels]
    cols = [p[1] for p in all_outline_pixels]
    center_r = sum(rows)/len(rows)
    center_c = sum(cols)/len(cols)
    print(f"Outline at ({center_r:.1f}, {center_c:.1f}), clicking...")
    
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': int(center_r), 'col': int(center_c)}])

        print("Level/game completed!")
        break
